messages:
maria gonzalez: Quick async on HarborHealth private rollout — putting the current checklist + blockers here. Ping owners if anything looks off.

jonathan kim: FYI infra/networking for staging is ✅. Prod VPC peering still pending — firewall team needs the CR to add customer CIDRs.

lee chen: I can own the peering CR. @maria please confirm CIDR + ports so I can fill the ticket.

maria gonzalez: CIDR is 10.40.0.0/16. Required ports: 443 outbound to customer LB, 22 restricted to bastion IPs (for debug only), 5432 to their read-replica range. No PrivateLink for this engagement. Added a short SG snippet below for copy/paste: 

```json
// example SG rules for prod-peering
[
  { "proto": "tcp", "port": 443, "cidr": "203.0.113.64/28", "desc": "Customer LB egress" },
  { "proto": "tcp", "port": 22, "cidr": "198.51.100.10/32", "desc": "Bastion access (customer)" },
  { "proto": "tcp", "port": 5432, "cidr": "203.0.113.72/29", "desc": "DB read replica" }
]
```

sam o'neil: Heads-up — airgap image sync on customer mirror stalled at 78%. Registry auth returned 401 while pulling redwood/private-runtime:prod-2026-03-10. I tried requeueing sync, no luck.

netops-bot: Detected failed pull from harbor-mirror-01. Error: 401 Unauthorized. Possible cause: expired mirror token or rotated registry cert. See https://internal.netops/harbor-sync for details.

sam o'neil: I suspect the mirror cert expired. @lee can you reconfirm the signed image bundle we provided for the airgap? If needed I'll coordinate a quick reupload.

lee chen: I will repackage and reupload the tarball with renewed certs. Will also regenerate checksum and post it here. ETA ~2h.

jonathan kim: I'll open the firewall CR now and assign to netops for approval. Tagging @sam for test plan so we can smoke the egress post-CR.

maria gonzalez: Plan check — can we target a canary cutover today 18:00 UTC if image reupload + peering + firewall are done by 16:30? If any of those slip, move to tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

sam o'neil: 18:00 works for me provided the image is fixed and I have access to the bastion creds to run the smoke tests.

lee chen: Reupload started. New checksum: sha256:4b7f2c9a8d3e5f1c2a77b0d9b3e8c9a2f5d6e7c8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0. I will post a link to the bundle when available.

netops-bot: Mirror health check will run automatically after upload. Notify with `@netops-bot check harbor-mirror-01` once done.

jonathan kim: Firewall CR created: CR-2026-1229, requesting peer from 10.40.0.0/16 to 203.0.113.64/28. Assigned to lee.

maria gonzalez: Owners clarified: peering = lee chen, image bundle = sam o'neil, firewall CR = jonathan kim. I'll handle customer comms and schedule. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Canary cluster 'harbor-canary-1' created in us-west-2 (id: canary-97).

sam o'neil: Once the mirror is healthy I'll run these smoke commands via bastion:

```bash
curl -sS https://harbor-canary-1.internal/health | jq .
ssh -i ~/.ssh/harbor_bastion ec2-user@bastion -L 5432:203.0.113.74:5432 -N
psql "host=localhost port=5432 user=readonly dbname=hh_test" -c 'select 1'
```

maria gonzalez: Sounds good. Let's reconvene here for status updates. If we hit any blocker before 16:30 call it out ASAP. Otherwise we aim 18:00 UTC canary. :rocket:

lee chen: Uploaded bundle link: https://internal-artifacts/harbor/harbor-health-bundle-2026-03-15.tar.gz — netops-bot, please run check.

netops-bot: Mirror check started for harbor-mirror-01. Expected completion 10m.

maria gonzalez: Thanks everyone — I'll update Confluence and send the customer a tentative 18:00 UTC canary window once we have green checks.
